theater: 馬其頓佩拉與色雷斯邊境

battle.name: 馬其頓擴張
battle.theater: 馬其頓佩拉與色雷斯邊境
battle.brief: 公元前三五八年，腓力二世在佩拉即位，先平佩奧尼亞與伊利里亞，再取奧林索斯、梅托涅與埃蓋，其後介入第三次神聖戰爭，三三八年以卡埃羅涅亞之役破希臘聯軍並建科林斯同盟。卡面的亞述長矛並未出現在此戰，它代表的是方陣核心武器薩里沙的技術源流：密集矛線與整體衝擊的祖型。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的起點是馬其頓王國本身。國土橫跨阿克修斯河谷的下馬其頓平原、北面奧林索斯山與西面皮埃里亞海岸，國都佩拉在河谷沼地與丘陵之間；國軍不是一支統一的常備軍，而是以王室親兵為骨幹、加上上馬其頓三個山區部族徵召兵團的混合體：重裝的「步友」方陣、規模約三千的「持盾衛」精銳步兵、編為若干中隊的「伙友」重騎兵，加上弓箭手、投槍手與工匠營，裝備相當一部分靠色雷斯與愛琴海沿岸雇來的傭兵。北方同時壓著三股勢力：伊利里亞人各部以首領巴爾底利斯為中心，佩奧尼亞人與色雷斯諸王刻爾索布勒普特斯、拉布俄斯彼此分合；南面是愛琴海沿岸的城邦，雅典、底比斯、科林斯與福基斯先後與馬其頓交鋒。與腓力聯手的還有埃利梅亞王德爾達斯、色雷斯西部各部，以及部分反對福基斯主導的城邦。對手一方則是福基斯聯盟的民兵、雅典與底比斯派出的雇傭兵、斯巴達系的援軍，以及後來由波斯王輸金接濟的聯盟軍。戰線從來不是一條：從佩拉向南是皮埃里亞海岸與塞薩利亞平原，向東沿斯特律蒙河谷通往色雷斯，向北則是通往伊利里亞內陸的山道。
countriesEn: The war began with the Macedonian kingdom itself. Its territory ran across the plain of Lower Macedonia in the valley of the Axius, the mountains of Orestis and Pangaion to the north, and the coast of Pieria to the west, with the capital Pella lying among the marshes and low hills of the river valley. The royal force was not a single standing army but a mixture built on the household troops and on levies from the three highland tribes of Upper Macedonia: the phalanx of the Foot Companions, a body of about three thousand elite Shield-bearers, the Companion cavalry organised in squadrons, together with archers, javelin-men and a corps of engineers, much of their equipment coming from mercenaries hired in Thrace and on the Aegean coast. Three pressures bore down on the north at once: the Illyrian tribes centred on the chieftain Bardylis, the Paeonians, and the Thracian kings Cersobleptes and Grabos, who acted separately or together; to the south lay the coastal cities of the Aegean, among them Athens, Thebes, Corinth and Phocis, which came to blows with Macedon in turn. Philip's allies included Derdas of Elimeia, the tribes of western Thrace, and a number of cities opposed to Phocis's leadership. The opposing side was the militia of the Phocian League, mercenaries sent by Athens and Thebes, a Spartan contingent, and later a coalition army financed by money from the Persian king. The front was never a single line: south from Pella lay the coast of Pieria and the plain of Thessaly, east ran the valley of the Strymon towards Thrace, and north led the mountain tracks into the Illyrian interior.
people: 核心人物是阿哈伊亞系的國王腓力二世。他生年一般作公元前三八二年前後，父親阿明塔斯三世被敵軍俘虜並客死埃蓋，留下王位被上馬其頓三個山區部族與下馬其頓平原貴族分割的局面；腓力少年時被送往底比斯作人質數年，在那裡接觸到希臘式的城邦外交、重步兵的組織與邦交手腕，歸國後又在一場宮廷陰謀中躲過暗殺：兄弟的姻親阿爾克塔斯在宴席上派人行刺，他殺出重圍，隨後被軍營的將領擁立為王。他的兩位哥哥佩爾迪卡斯三世與菲利普相繼在一場對伊利里亞人的戰役中陣亡：前者被巴爾底利斯陣中的人物所殺，後者據說為一名克里特弓手射殺；腓力收復兩人的遺骨，在邁澤阿興起墳，之後又向那位通曉底比斯軍制的將領致敬並讓他參與宮廷。王位旁邊是王子亞歷山大三世，公元前三五六年生，十八歲時在卡埃羅涅亞率伙友騎兵與方陣左翼，因擊潰底比斯聖隊而一戰成名；亞里士多德自公元前三四三年起在邁澤阿教他。馬其頓方面的將領以帕爾梅尼翁最有名，腓力的兒子阿明塔斯在梅托涅陣亡；亞歷山大即位後由安提帕特攝政，卡山德隨後奪位。希臘方面值得記住的名字有：福基斯的奧諾馬科斯、菲羅墨洛斯、達摩斯提尼與多里馬科斯；雅典的將軍卡瑞斯與福克基翁，遊走各城邦的伊索克瑞特，長期遊說馬其頓的德摩斯提尼；斯巴達王阿基達穆斯三世率軍援福基斯，最終戰死在麥加洛波利斯。
peopleEn: The central figure was Philip II, king of the Aeacids. His birth is usually put at around 382 BC. His father Amyntas III had been captured and had died in captivity at Aegae, leaving the throne divided between the three highland tribes of Upper Macedonia and the plains aristocracy of the lower kingdom. Philip spent part of his youth as a hostage at Thebes, where he absorbed Greek diplomacy, the organisation of heavy infantry and the arts of treaty-making; on his return he survived an attempted murder in the palace, for his brother's father-in-law Alcetas had men strike at him during a banquet and he killed his way out, after which the officers of the army acclaimed him king. His two elder brothers, Perdiccas III and Philip, fell in turn in a war against the Illyrians: Perdiccas was killed by a man of Bardylis's party, and Philip, it is said, by a Cretan archer. The new king recovered their bones and raised a tomb for them at Mieza, and he later honoured the Theban officer who had taught him, admitting him to the court. Beside the throne stood the prince Alexander III, born in 356 BC, who at eighteen commanded the Companion cavalry and the left wing of the phalanx at Chaeronea and made his name by breaking the Theban Sacred Band; Aristotle began teaching him at Mieza in 343 BC. The best known Macedonian general was Parmenion, and Philip's son Amyntas was killed at Methone. After Alexander's accession Antipater governed as regent, and Cassander later seized the throne. On the Greek side the names worth remembering are Onomarchus, Philomelus, Damosthenes and Dorimachus of Phocis; the Athenian generals Chares and Phocion; Isocrates, who travelled among the cities; and Demosthenes, who courted Macedon for years. The Spartan king Archidamus III came to the aid of Phocis and was killed at Megalopolis.
kits: 卡面這支亞述長矛是本場戰爭的技術祖型，但它本身並沒有出現在公元前四世紀的戰場上。亞述王國在公元前六一二年尼尼微陷落、前六〇九年哈蘭失守之後便已瓦解，亞述的方陣步兵裝備隨之退場：短柄、長刃，鐵鏃套在木柄上，配大尺寸的盾牌，與弓手、鐵劍手混編，在多國聯軍的大方陣裡以數量壓過城邦民兵——這是亞述對希臘步兵制度的第一份改寫。腓力二世真正拿在手裡的是薩里沙：四至六公尺長、雙手握持、前端細小的鐵矛頭、尾端帶一枚鐵尾錐，既能刺也能在隊形受擠時撐地撐身。尾錐是關鍵，它讓矛兵在密集縱隊裡互相支撐，使方陣必須保持十數排的縱深。伊利里亞人與高盧人用的蘇爾皮撒、塞薩利亞與色雷斯騎兵用的克西托姆長矛、佩奧尼亞與色雷斯的弧形小盾佩爾塔，都是同期並存的形制。短兵器方面，馬其頓方陣用科皮斯彎刀砍殺，頭盔以青銅為主，盾牌是雙握把的小圓盾「阿斯庇斯」，鎧甲多為亞麻束甲與鑲片胸甲。攻城一方出現真正的技術革命：可拆卸的塔樓、撞槌、填壕的柴束，以及狄奧多羅斯記載的「第一位把扭力弩砲用於攻城」；梅托涅一役，腓力在沼澤上築起堤道，把砲兵與塔樓推上泥灘，砲擊與撞擊同時破牆。運力靠牛拉的貨車與雙輪車，馬匹、飼料與食糧自佩拉與埃蓋的倉儲出發，隨軍工匠營還自帶鍛爐，修補矛頭與甲片。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on this card is the technological ancestor of the war, but the weapon itself never appeared on a battlefield of the fourth century BC. The Assyrian state collapsed with the fall of Nineveh in 612 BC and the loss of Harran in 609 BC, and the equipment of the Assyrian infantry went down with it: a short shaft with a long blade, an iron head socketed onto the wood, carried with a large shield, mixed in companies with archers and swordsmen, and used in massed multinational formations to overwhelm the citizen militias of the cities, which was the Assyrians' first rewrite of Greek infantry doctrine. What Philip II actually carried was the sarissa: four to six metres, held in both hands, with a small iron head at the front and an iron butt-spike at the rear, able both to thrust and, when the line was pressed, to brace against the ground. The butt-spike is the crucial part, because it lets one spearman support another inside a dense column, and that is what obliges the phalanx to be kept many ranks deep. The surpiza of the Illyrians and Gauls, the xyston of the Thessalian and Thracian cavalry, and the small crescent pelta of the Paeonians and Thracians all existed alongside it. For close work the Macedonian phalanx carried the kopis, a curved cutting sword; helmets were mainly bronze, the shield was the small round aspis with a double grip, and body armour was chiefly linen gusset armour or plated corslets. On the siege side came a genuine technical revolution: dismantlable towers, battering rams, brushwood for filling ditches, and, as Diodorus records, the first recorded use of torsion artillery in siege work by Philip. At Methone he built a causeway across the marsh and brought artillery and towers up onto the mud, breaking the wall by shot and by ram at the same time. Transport rested on ox-drawn carts and two-wheeled vehicles; horses, fodder and grain left the magazines at Pella and Aegae, and the engineer corps carried its own forges to refit spearheads and armour plates on the march.
tactics: 方陣是腓力的答案，但不是唯一的答案。他把希臘式重步兵縱隊改成以薩里沙為核心的縱深方陣：每一「縱隊」五百人，分為百人「連」、五十人「排」，再細分到十人與五人；列陣時盾牌交疊成連續的牆，縱深一般解讀為十六排，縱隊之間留出讓矛兵轉向的間隔。進攻不是奔跑，而是整體推壓：以盾牆頂住對手的推擠，前排刺擊，後排用尾錐撐住前面，陣形一旦散開就再也無法重整，所以方陣必須成建制、有縱深地整體推進。卡埃羅涅亞的部署是教科書式的兩面鉗擊：腓力把亞歷山大放在方陣左翼對住底比斯聖隊與聯軍左翼，聯軍右翼的塞薩利亞重騎兵一度衝穿右翼陣線，腓力乘機令方陣中央前推；亞歷山大的伙友騎兵擊潰塞薩利亞騎兵後迴轉夾擊聯軍右翼，聯軍右翼朝波耳斐里俄斯河方向潰散，中路與左翼同時被壓垮，底比斯聖隊被從側後捲入，全軍崩潰。攻城方面，腓力在梅托涅以堤道跨沼澤，砲兵與塔樓同時上灘，並配合內牆突破口與突擊隊，狄奧多羅斯稱他是首位把扭力弩砲用於攻城的人。他也示範了另一種戰法：不與大國正面結盟，而是在意利亞、希臘、色雷斯三線同時施壓，用外交把敵人孤立，再用一支支輕裝快速縱隊插入對方腹地，在對方援軍抵達前結束戰鬥。
tacticsEn: The phalanx was Philip's answer, but not his only one. He turned the Greek heavy infantry column into a deep formation built around the sarissa: each file of five hundred men was divided into companies of a hundred, then sections of fifty, down to platoons of ten and sections of five. On deployment the shields overlapped into a continuous wall, the depth is generally read as sixteen ranks, and intervals were left between files so that the spearmen could turn. The advance was not a charge but a push: the shield wall held off the enemy pressure, the front ranks thrust, the rear ranks braced the front with their butt-spikes, and once a formation was broken it could never be reformed, so the phalanx had to advance as an intact body with depth. The deployment at Chaeronea is a textbook double pincer. Philip put Alexander on the left wing of the phalanx opposite the Theban Sacred Band and the allied left, while the Thessalian heavy cavalry of the allied right broke through the right wing of the line for a moment, and Philip used that moment to push the centre forward. Alexander's Companion cavalry beat the Thessalian horse, wheeled, and struck the allied right in the flank; that wing broke towards the river Spercheios, the centre and the left were crushed at the same time, the Theban Sacred Band was rolled up from the rear and flank, and the whole allied army came apart. On the siege side, at Methone Philip carried a causeway across the marsh, brought artillery and towers up over the mud at once, and combined a breach in the inner wall with an assault column; Diodorus names him the first man to use torsion artillery in siege operations. He also demonstrated a second method: instead of making a single great alliance, he applied pressure on three fronts at once in Italy, Greece and Thrace, used diplomacy to isolate his opponents, and then sent light and fast columns into the enemy's interior to end the fighting before reinforcements could arrive.
data: 可核對的數字多屬估算或古典作家的記載，須逐一對照年代表。年份方面：腓力二世在位自公元前三五八或三五九至三三六年，亞歷山大三三六至三二三年；第三次神聖戰爭為三五六至三四六年；梅托涅圍城約在三五五至三五四年，奧林索斯陷於三四八年，卡埃羅涅亞之役在三三八年，底比斯於三三五年被拆，腓力在三三六年遇刺。數量方面：伙友騎兵約三千人，傳統估算「持盾衛」約三千人，「步友」起家時約六千人；卡埃羅涅亞前線的腓力軍常被記作約三萬步兵、五千騎兵，聯軍方面的總數各家分歧更大；狄奧多羅斯記聯軍陣亡約一萬、被俘約三千，馬其頓軍損失約二千，並記亞歷山大在對付塞薩利亞騎兵時僅折損約二十人，這類數字出自作家的戰報，屬上限而非實測。奧林索斯陷落後遭販運為奴者以萬計，狄奧多羅斯的記載達數萬人。距離方面：佩拉至梅托涅約五十公里，至阿姆菲波利斯約七十公里，至色雷斯峽灣陸路超過二百公里。紀念工程上，腓力在奧林匹亞奉獻的宙斯巨像高逾十公尺，耗金達數百塔蘭特。一九七七年考古學家在埃蓋的「王冢二號」發現劫後墓室與金飾殘件，一般認為即腓力二世之墓。月份方面，古典文獻只把伊利里亞之戰繫於王位第二年，卡片月份欄按春季出兵的常例記為四月，屬編年慣例而非確證。
dataEn: Most of the figures that can be checked are either estimates or numbers preserved by the ancient writers, and they have to be read against a chronology. On dates: Philip II reigned from 358 or 359 BC to 336 BC, Alexander from 336 to 323 BC; the Third Sacred War ran from 356 to 346 BC; the siege of Methone fell in 355 or 354 BC, Olynthus fell in 348 BC, the battle of Chaeronea was fought in 338 BC, Thebes was destroyed in 335 BC, and Philip was assassinated in 336 BC. On numbers: the Companion cavalry numbered about three thousand, the traditional estimate for the Shield-bearers is about three thousand, and the Foot Companions began with about six thousand; the Macedonian army at Chaeronea is commonly given as about thirty thousand foot and five thousand horse, while the totals for the allies vary far more from writer to writer. Diodorus records about ten thousand allied dead and about three thousand prisoners, about two thousand Macedonian dead, and only about twenty men lost by Alexander against the Thessalian cavalry; figures of that kind come from a battle narrative and are upper limits rather than counts. After the fall of Olynthus tens of thousands were sold into slavery, Diodorus' account running to several tens of thousands. On distances: Pella to Methone is about fifty kilometres, to Amphipolis about seventy, and overland to the Thracian Chersonese more than two hundred. As a monumental work, the Colossus of Zeus dedicated by Philip at Olympia stood more than ten metres high and consumed several hundred talents of gold. In 1977 archaeologists opened the looted tomb called Tomb Two at Aegae and recovered gold fittings, generally taken to be the tomb of Philip II. On months: the ancient literature fixes the Illyrian war only to the second year of the reign, so the month field on the card takes April, the usual season for a spring campaign, as a chronological convention rather than as an established fact.
cause: 這場擴張的第一因是邊境危機與王位繼承的真空。公元前四世紀五〇年代末，伊利里亞人越過山道進入馬其頓南部平原，佩爾迪卡斯三世與菲利普相繼戰死，上馬其頓三個山區部族與下馬其頓平原貴族各懷算盤，國王只是部落聯盟的共主而非有效的君主；腓力在兄弟的遺骸與危機之間登位，必須先把佩奧尼亞人、伊利里亞人與色雷斯王的年年掠奪壓下去，否則佩拉與奧林索斯山的金礦、山麓的良田就要不斷淪為戰場。第二因是結構性的財政需求：馬其頓國小民寡，王室收入遠不足以維持一支現金支薪的常備軍，而希臘城邦可以靠同盟者、稅收與海運維持大規模傭兵軍，腓力要追上希臘的戰爭規模，就必須先奪取礦產、土地與航路。第三因是福基斯引發的神聖戰爭提供了一個合法而有力的介入名分：福基斯聯盟要求取得德爾斐與安菲克提翁議會的領導權，雅典與底比斯出兵干預，波斯王的金錢也流到福基斯與斯巴達一邊，腓力以安菲克提翁領袖的名義介入，一舉把別人的宗教衝突變成自己的戰爭，同時取得議會的徵稅權與調解權。第四因是腓力個人的制度設計：他從底比斯人質歲月裡帶回希臘的外交手腕，又把馬其頓的部落徵召制改造成以王室為核心的常備軍，用土地、薪酬與婚姻綁住貴族，讓擴張的成本變成長期制度而非一次性徵發，並把家世寫進奧林匹亞的基因表以宣示阿爾戈斯血統的正當性。
causeEn: The first cause of the expansion was a crisis on the frontier combined with a vacuum in the succession. In the late 350s BC the Illyrians came over the mountain tracks into the plain of southern Macedonia, Perdiccas III and Philip were killed in turn, the three highland tribes of Upper Macedonia and the plains aristocracy went their own ways, and the king was only the nominal head of a tribal league rather than an effective monarch. Taking the throne among his brothers' bones and a crisis, Philip had to push back the yearly raids of the Paeonians, the Illyrians and the Thracian kings, or the gold of Pangaion and the good land at the foot of the hills would be a battlefield every year. The second cause was structural and financial: Macedon was a small kingdom with few subjects, and the royal revenues could never pay a cash salary to a standing army of the size Greek cities maintained through allies, taxes and seaborne trade. To match the scale of Greek war, Philip had to take mineral wealth, land and sea lanes first. The third cause was the Sacred War raised by Phocis, which gave him a legitimate and powerful reason to intervene: the Phocian League claimed the leadership of Delphi and of the Amphictyonic Council, Athens and Thebes sent troops, and money from the Persian king flowed to Phocis and to Sparta. Entering the war as leader of the Amphictyons, Philip turned somebody else's religious quarrel into his own war and picked up the right of the council to levy contributions and to mediate. The fourth cause was Philip's own institutional design. He brought back from his hostage years at Thebes the Greek art of diplomacy, and he turned the tribal levy into a standing army with the royal household at its core, binding the nobility to the crown with land, pay and marriages, so that the cost of expansion became a permanent system rather than a single conscription. He also wrote his lineage into the Olympic geneaology to assert the legitimacy of his Argive descent.
impact: 這場擴張改變了古典世界的政治版圖，也改變了兵器的歷史。制度上，希臘城邦的獨立從此名存實亡：三三八年卡埃羅涅亞之後成立的科林斯同盟，以馬其頓主宰的名義取代了自主的同盟體，底比斯於三三五年被拆，雅典交出艦隊並接受呂庫爾戈斯的改革，泛希臘的城邦政治在幾十年內退場。隨後便是亞歷山大承續同一套兵制東征：三三四年渡赫勒斯滂，多利米、伊斯蘇斯、高加米拉三役滅阿契美尼德帝國，希臘語隨軍隊成為亞歷山大繼承者的通用語；錢幣上，腓力開創的金幣「斯塔特」與銀幣「德拉克馬」成為整個希臘化世界的通商標準；軍人殖民與駐屯城市把希臘城鎮制推向中亞與南亞。軍事的反面教訓同樣深遠：波利比奧斯在《歷史》中指出，縱深重裝方陣雖能勝過希臘的輕步兵，卻在面對羅馬的機動性與地形考驗時代價高昂，羅馬人正是靠與馬其頓長期交戰，才在公元前二世紀逼出軍團的調整，最終於皮埃努斯之役殲滅馬其頓王國。反過來說，亞述式的「密集矛兵加遠射」基因，經希臘重步兵、馬其頓薩里沙方陣一路傳到中世紀歐洲的長槍方陣，中間的傳承雖不斷被重新發明，方向從未改變。
impactEn: The expansion redrew the political map of the classical world and changed the history of weapons. Institutionally, the independence of the Greek city states became nominal: the League of Corinth formed after Chaeronea in 338 BC replaced the autonomous alliances under Macedonian hegemony, Thebes was destroyed in 335 BC, and Athens gave up its fleet and accepted the reforms of Lycurgus, so that pan-Hellenic civic politics disappeared within a few decades. Then Alexander carried the same military system east: crossing the Hellespont in 334 BC, he destroyed the Achaemenid Empire at Granicus, Issus and Gaugamela, and Greek became the common language of his successors. In coinage, the gold staters and silver drachmas of Philip became the trade standard of the entire Hellenistic world, and military colonies and garrison towns carried the Greek polis form into Central Asia and South Asia. The military lessons cut the other way as well: in the Histories Polybius argued that a deep heavy phalanx, though able to beat the light infantry of Greece, was ruinously expensive when it met Roman mobility and Roman ground, and the Romans only adjusted their legions after long wars with Macedon, eventually destroying the Macedonian kingdom at Pydna in the second century BC. The other way round, the Assyrian formula of massed spearmen combined with missile troops passed, through the Greek hoplite and the Macedonian sarissa phalanx, all the way to the pike block of medieval Europe; the transmission was repeatedly reinvented, but its direction never changed.
result: 結果是雙重的。一方面是馬其頓的勝利：福基斯聯盟在三四六年崩解，被掠走的德爾斐神藏被追回並歸還神廟，福基斯人遭到流放；奧林索斯同盟在三四八年被拆，色雷斯王刻爾索布勒普特斯於三四一年死於宮廷陰謀，色雷斯不再作為獨立強國存在；伊利里亞人退回山地，馬其頓的邊界推到斯特律蒙河與愛琴海；阿姆菲波利斯成為通往赫勒斯滂的鑰匙，馬其頓王國從一個內陸部落聯盟變成控制東地中海門戶的強國。一方面是代價與未竟：腓力在戰爭的最高點被自己宮廷裡的帕奧尼亞侍從保薩尼阿斯刺死於埃蓋，三三六年亞歷山大被迫在二十歲即位，王室的計畫、聯盟的忠誠與國庫的收支都留給他一人收拾；聯軍的記憶並未消失，亞歷山大在東方取得的每一次勝利都在希臘本土引發新的恐慌，最終亞歷山大於三二三年死於巴比倫，帝國在他留下的數個繼承者手中分裂，聯盟式的一致連續四十年都未能重建——這正是「馬其頓擴張」最終留下的形狀：它拆掉了舊世界，卻沒有造出一個能長久維持的新世界。
resultEn: The result was double. On one side there was the Macedonian victory. The Phocian League broke up in 346 BC, the Delphic treasures that had been carried off were recovered and returned to the temple, and the Phocians were exiled; the Olynthian League was pulled down in 348 BC; the Thracian king Cersobleptes died in a palace intrigue in 341 BC, after which Thrace was no longer an independent power; the Illyrians were driven back into the mountains and the Macedonian frontier was pushed out to the Strymon and the Aegean; Amphipolis became the key to the Hellespont, and the kingdom of Macedon turned from an inland tribal league into a state holding the doorway of the eastern Mediterranean. On the other side were the cost and the unfinished business. At the high point of the war Philip was killed at Aegae by Pausanias, a Paeonian serving in his own court, and in 336 BC Alexander was forced onto the throne at twenty, left alone with the royal plan, the loyalty of the allies and the state of the treasury. The memory of the coalition did not die: every victory Alexander won in the east raised fresh panic in Greece, and when he died at Babylon in 323 BC the empire broke apart among the successors he left behind, and no league-wide unity was rebuilt for forty years. That is the final shape of the Macedonian expansion: it pulled the old world down without building a new one that could hold.
